declared_exclusions.item: The DEPLOY proof genre the order's header marks
declared_exclusions.reason: The order declares <proof_genre>DEPLOY</proof_genre> together with <risk>LOCAL</risk>, and those cannot both hold: proof-of-spec-check admits genre DEPLOY only on an order marked <risk>SERVED</risk> or <risk>WORLD</risk> (3.0.0_SA_CVO verdict 29306, condition 1), and the schema then also requires a never_widen_pair, which the CTO's own ruling says this act does not need because a verified DELTA=0 needs no pair. This instance is therefore written as genre BUILD, the only genre it can honestly claim -- the checker states that the graded party cannot confer DEPLOY on itself. Nothing about the work changes; what changes is which limbs grade it, and a BUILD instance is graded more strictly, not less. The header needs ONE of two issuer amendments: <risk>SERVED</risk> if the DEPLOY genre is intended, or <proof_genre>BUILD</proof_genre> if LOCAL is intended. That is the issuer's field to amend, not the applier's, and it is raised in the report rather than worked around silently.
